scope: Offline exact source-derived input-fit counts for the final frozen 60-request launch manifest; no model/API/tokenization endpoint call, model load, download, package install, or source-image visual review in this unit.
image_capability: This harness can inspect local images using image viewing tools; visual inspection was outside this bounded input-fit unit.

request_manifest.request_contract: Frozen request bytes, text/image payloads, model digests, options, and response schema are bound in the launch manifest. Counts are source-derived from pinned tokenizer/renderer/media code and recorded separately in counts.json.

environment.ollama_tokenizer_go_package_source: not available in local Go module cache or checked-in project source
environment.network_source_fetch: primary raw.githubusercontent URLs returned cache-miss; no source was fetched

pinned_private_tokenize_route.finding: POST /v1/tokenize invokes runner.Load before routes are registered and tokenizes the raw text body with the model tokenizer/BOS policy; it does not render the chat request or expand media. It is also a model-loading route.
pinned_private_tokenize_route.decision: Rejected for this task: it violates no model loading/call, and does not yield request-fit parity.

pinned_prepare_path.finding: Text-only inputs use tokenizer encoding; multimodal inputs call model.MediaModel.expandMedia. The resulting tokens are checked against context and output reserve.
pinned_prepare_path.alternative: Potential fail-closed runtime guard after media expansion: runner checks context before generation, so oversized input should be rejected instead of silently truncated on this source revision.
pinned_prepare_path.limits: The installed binary reports vcs.modified=true; source behavior is not proven byte-for-byte identical. No request was made, so the actual installed runtime guard was not exercised. This is not an offline fit count.

pinned_tokenizer.finding: Exact Ollama tokenizer source is pure Go with only external import golang.org/x/text/unicode/norm. A temporary isolated offline Go helper compiled the pinned package and counted all frozen request prompts with exact renderer segmentation/BOS behavior.
pinned_tokenizer.limit: Tokenizer text counts alone are not full multimodal counts. Full counts are now computed by adding source-derived model-specific image expansion token counts from CPU geometry; binary parity caveat remains.

server_chat_truncation.finding: The chat route defaults Truncate to true but forcibly sets it false for m.IsMLX() before chatPrompt. API type comments define Truncate as chat-history truncation. For these MLX models, the approximate 768-token-per-image chatPrompt trimming branch is bypassed; current frozen requests have one system and one user message, and the entire rendered request proceeds to the runner.

mlx_context_guard.finding: Runner sets contextLength from model.MaxContextLength() at load. Prepare tokenizes or calls model.MediaModel.PrepareMedia via expandMedia, rejects empty prompt and rejects len(expanded tokens) >= contextLength before generation. On success it sets PromptEvalCount to len(request.Tokens), the exact rendered-plus-expanded prompt token count, in the completion response.
mlx_context_guard.requested_num_ctx: The source does not apply per-request Options.NumCtx in Prepare. The guard is against model maximum context, not frozen request option num_ctx=16384. Saved model metadata reports 262144 for Qwen/Gemma and 131072 for Muse. Do not claim the 16384 target is enforced.
mlx_context_guard.output_reserve: Prepare caps NumPredict to model_context_length-len(tokens). Therefore the requested4096 output budget may be silently reduced when less than4096 tokens remain. For a successful future request, PromptEvalCount plus4096 <= confirmed model context proves at least4096 tokens fit after the input; a larger count proves the requested reserve was capped. This is post-request evidence, not offline preflight.
mlx_context_guard.source_to_binary_caveat: The installed binary reports vcs.modified=true; pinned behavior is verified at source revision but not byte-for-byte matched to the binary. No model/API request was run to exercise this guard.

media_expansion.finding: expandMedia splits exact [img-N] tags, tokenizes text segments with BOS only on first segment, and calls PrepareMedia. Model PrepareMedia decodes/resizes/patchifies on CPU; token expansion length is derived from image geometry. Qwen emits vision-start + merged H/W patch grid + vision-end; Gemma emits BOI + NumSoftTokens + EOI; Glimmer emits image-start + outputTokens patch markers + image-end. The pure-Go helper reproduced these lengths from config and image dimensions, without loading weights or invoking MLX.
media_expansion.source_to_binary_caveat: Counts are pinned-source derived, not verified against the modified installed binary.
media_expansion.limitations: Image preprocessing executes CPU decode/resize/patchify when the server handles the request, but only the geometry-derived placeholder lengths are needed by this offline counter; no model weights, MLX encoder, GPU, or inference are involved.

feasibility.exact_offline_counting_now: Feasible for all 60 frozen requests using pinned pure-Go Ollama tokenizer plus exact fixed-shape renderer and per-model media expansion token geometry. Counts include rendered text tokenization and image placeholder expansion. The source path also performs CPU decode/resize/patchify, but token count depends on resized geometry and requires no model weights, MLX encoder, GPU, or inference.
limits: Pinned Ollama source commit differs from the installed executable provenance: binary reports vcs.modified=true; source-to-binary byte parity is not established.
The requested 16384 context and 4096 generation envelope is checked offline against source-derived input counts, not validated in a live run.
No model/API request, model loading, private tokenization route, or GPU work was performed.
not_attempted: No model/API request, tokenizer private route, warmup, MLX load, or inference.
No dependency installation or model download.
No text/character/byte heuristic reported as token count.

actionable_next_path: Use counts.json as the offline source-derived input-fit evidence for the frozen launch manifest; all 60 satisfy total_input_tokens+4096<=16384.

Before any separately authorized launch, verify the installed Ollama binary is the intended build/revision or explicitly accept the recorded source-to-binary caveat. Do not rely on its model-max context guard to enforce request num_ctx=16384: pinned Prepare uses the model maximum and may reduce NumPredict.
A future runtime validation, if authorized by the master plan, can compare response PromptEvalCount to the offline count and confirm output-budget handling. No runtime request was made in this unit.
decision: All 60 frozen requests have offline source-derived complete input counts; every request fits the requested 16384 context plus 4096 output reserve under the pinned renderer/tokenizer/media rules. This closes offline fit uncertainty for this manifest, but does not prove installed-binary parity or exercise the runtime. P0 and launch readiness remain as recorded in MASTER_PLAN.md.
